title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Written Retainer Agreements
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: While the Law Society highly recommends written retainer agreements for all matters, in which of the following scenarios is a written agreement strictly **mandatory**?
options: When representing a family member for free.
When entering into a contingency fee agreement or a joint retainer.
When handling a Highway Traffic Act ticket.
When acting as a Notary Public.
questions.explain: The Solicitors Act and LSO Rules make written retainers legally mandatory for contingency fee arrangements. Furthermore, Rule 3.04 makes written acknowledgement of conflict disclosure mandatory in joint retainers. (Note: The LSO strongly recommends them for all retainers).
